outcome: duration of breastfeeding (4 and 6 months postpartum)
cohort: The study included 49,669 Norwegian mothers from the MoBa (Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study) with complete information on BMI, GWG, and breastfeeding.
finding: Excess risk of unsuccessful breastfeeding initiation was observed among prepregnant overweight and obese women, as well as prepregnant underweight women with GWG below recommendations, while prepregnant obese women with GWG above recommendations had the highest risk of inability to sustain breastfeeding.
